parents.subject: Food Science and Human Nutrition
parents.course: Advanced Topics in Food Science and Human Nutrition

ns2:section.sectionText: Provide students with the concepts and methods necessary for producing food ingredients and fermented foods through precision fermentation. Topics include microbial cell culture methods, recombinant DNA techniques, transformation, genome editing, bioreactor operation, and applications of precision fermentation.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, PHD:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, MS: Food Sc Hum N - PSM -UIUC, or MS:Bioprocess & Bioenergy-UIUC.
